description: A macOS Electron desktop app for batch-querying CD information by catalog number across Discogs, eBay, Kojima Rokuon, and Mercari, with anti-scraping bypass, local history, and Excel export.

userStories.title: Initialize Electron + React project scaffold
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a working Electron + React project scaffold so that subsequent stories can build on it.
acceptanceCriteria: Electron app launches with a React-based main window
Hot reload works in development mode
Package.json has scripts for dev, build, and lint
App window has a placeholder layout with left panel and right panel
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add SQLite database schema for query results
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a SQLite database with tables for query results so that CD data can be persisted locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Initialize better-sqlite3 database on app startup in user data directory
Create 'queries' table: id, catalog_number, created_at
Create 'results' table: id, query_id, platform, name, artist, price_min, price_max, cover_url, link, status ('found'|'not_found'|'error')
Migration runs automatically on app start
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add secure settings storage for API keys and cookies
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a secure settings store so that user-provided API tokens and cookies are persisted safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings store backed by electron-store with encryption enabled
Schema supports: discogsToken, ebayClientId, ebayClientSecret, cookies (object with discogs/ebay/kojima/mercari keys)
Expose IPC handlers: getSettings, setSetting, deleteSetting
Settings persist across app restarts
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Set up Puppeteer stealth scraping engine
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Puppeteer instance with stealth plugin so that scraping can bypass basic anti-bot detection.
acceptanceCriteria: Puppeteer bundled within Electron app using puppeteer-core + local Chromium
puppeteer-extra-plugin-stealth applied to all browser instances
Dynamic fingerprinting: rotate User-Agent, viewport size, and WebGL vendor strings per session
Browser instance pool managed with acquire/release pattern (max 2 concurrent)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add request throttling middleware
userStories.description: As a developer, I need request throttling so that scraping requests mimic human behavior and avoid rate limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Per-domain throttle queue with randomized 2-6 second delay between requests
429 responses trigger exponential backoff (2s, 4s, 8s, then fail)
When all retries exhausted, return error status with message indicating manual intervention needed
Throttle state exposed via IPC: getThrottleStatus
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement Discogs query module
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Discogs query module so the app can fetch CD info from Discogs by catalog number.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary: call Discogs search API with user-provided token, search by catalog_number field
Fallback: stealth-scrape Discogs search page if API returns error or no token
Extract from results: name, artist, price_min, price_max, cover_url, link
Return { status: 'not_found' } when no results
Inject user cookies from settings when scraping
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement eBay query module
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an eBay query module so the app can fetch CD listing info from eBay by catalog number.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary: call eBay Browse API with OAuth credentials from settings
Fallback: stealth-scrape eBay search results page
Extract from results: name, price_min, price_max, cover_url, link
Return { status: 'not_found' } when no results
Inject user cookies from settings when scraping
Typecheck passes

acceptanceCriteria: Stealth-scrape kojimarokuon.com search page using catalog number (no public API)
Handle Japanese-language pages and UTF-8 character encoding correctly
Extract from results: name, artist, price_min, price_max, cover_url, link

acceptanceCriteria: Stealth-scrape mercari.com search page using catalog number (no stable public API)
Extract from results: name, price_min, price_max, cover_url, link
Return { status: 'not_found' } when no results

userStories.title: Build query orchestrator with parallel execution
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a query orchestrator that runs all 4 platform queries in parallel per CD and handles batches of up to 10 CDs.
acceptanceCriteria: Accept array of up to 10 catalog numbers
For each catalog number, query all 4 platforms in parallel
Control concurrency: max 3 catalog numbers processed simultaneously
Emit IPC events for progress: query:start, query:progress, query:complete, query:error
Save all results to SQLite after each catalog number completes
Return aggregated results when entire batch finishes
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Build input panel UI for catalog numbers
userStories.description: As a user, I want to enter up to 10 CD catalog numbers so I can start a search.
acceptanceCriteria: Left panel contains a textarea for catalog numbers (one per line or comma-separated)
Validate: show error message if empty or more than 10 entries
Search button triggers IPC call to query orchestrator
Search button shows disabled/loading state while query is running
Support dark mode via macOS system appearance
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Build settings panel UI
userStories.description: As a user, I want to configure API tokens and cookies so the app can access protected platforms.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings panel accessible via menu or toolbar icon
Input fields for: Discogs API token, eBay Client ID, eBay Client Secret
Cookie input textarea per platform (Discogs, eBay, Kojima Rokuon, Mercari)
Save button writes settings via IPC; values load on panel open

acceptanceCriteria: Right panel displays result cards grouped by catalog number
Each card shows: catalog number, CD name, artist, cover image thumbnail, per-platform price range with link
Cover images load asynchronously with placeholder while loading
Platform names shown with recognizable label/icon per row

userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the lowest price highlighted and clear 'Not Found' indicators so I can quickly identify the best deal.
acceptanceCriteria: Lowest price across all platforms highlighted in green within each result card
Platforms with no results show a 'Not Found' badge instead of price

userStories.description: As a user, I want to see real-time progress while queries are running so I know the app is working.

userStories.description: As a user, I want to view past queries so I can reference previously searched CDs offline.
acceptanceCriteria: History tab/section lists all past query batches with timestamp and catalog numbers

Exported file opens correctly in Excel/Numbers/Google Sheets

userStories.description: As a user, I want an Export to Excel button so I can save my search results as a spreadsheet.
